parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS content_id, c.business_id, pl.platform, pl.platform_post_id, b.enabled_platforms FROM content c JOIN publish_log pl ON pl.content_id = c.id JOIN businesses b ON b.id = c.business_id WHERE c.status = 'published' AND pl.status = 'success' AND pl.platform_post_id IS NOT NULL AND c.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY c.published_at DESC LIMIT 100
